channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Pentagon fires general it says leaked classified information to media
item.description: Army Lieutenant General Brett Sylvia was subject of investigation into leaking information about Iran and Ukraine.

item.title: At least 14 people killed in attack on Ukraine train station
item.description: A Russian drone strike killed at least 14 people at Dnipro’s main railway station in central Ukraine.

item.title: Spanish long jumper Julieta Gallego among victims of deadly train collision
item.description: Julieta Gallego, who competed for Madrid-based AD Sprint, among those killed in train crash in Spain.

item.title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
item.description: With 99% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies are set to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset.

item.title: Watch: At the scene of Spain's deadly train crash
item.description: People have been killed after a Spanish high-speed train collided with another train south of the capital Madrid, making this the country's worst disaster since 2013.

item.title: How could Israel break election deadlock? Here are four scenarios
item.description: With more than 90% of votes counted, all signs point to an impasse. The most likely outcome may be new elections.
